== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Missing data ===
* Moved from "Gaps and uncertainties":
** Redux / Re-Edit primary program pages still thin; VS7-11 "Official text as of 4 Dec 2006" is not proven first ship (see [[Virtual Sets (2002-2009)]]).
** Modern starwarsccg.org takeover / org-transfer story unknown as a full narrative. Domain/server move is cited (news.php?id=69, 10 June 2009). An earlier HTML archive also showed the domain forward by 5 July 2009.
** Drop lists between pre-reorg / Block / Reset pools not tabulated. Full inventories of dropped cards are out of scope until sourced.
** Block announcement URLs (Aug/Sep 2009) not found; only the 7 Dec 2009 PDF stamp is cited.
** 2014 Reset announcement: "~14 July 2014 (Category One-era reporting)" with no stable permalink. October 2014 community summaries discuss the new pool (no link given).
** Exact legal dates for most of VS3-VS18 and Defensive Shields are not cited from primary announcements.
** Whether every star-wars.pl subtitle matches PC marketing names needs checking against slip covers/announcements.
** VS18 appears on a secondary list but not in the PC slips "Sets 1-17" heading.
** Community nicknames (Redux, Revolution, etc.) only partly tied to primary PC terminology.
* [[Virtual Set 0]] / [[Virtual Set D]] date of 24 September 2014 comes from the Main Page Current Virtual band; it has no citation on this page.
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Defensive Shields as part of 2002-2009 Virtual releases came from "secondary chronologies"; now cited to star-wars.pl (ref "swpl"). Confirm against a PC source.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* Opening note: "Community history is messy. This page prefers dated primary or archived sources and labels secondary/uncertain claims."
* Logos intro: "Former and current marks in a dated side-by-side (Wikipedia-style historical logos pattern; not a single hero image). Captions cite primary sources."
* "soft-label Premium Set 1 historical" (after Defensive Shields; no source).
* "Terms such as community "Redux" / "Revolution" appear in period set naming (for example secondary lists call Virtual Set 3 "Revolution") but this page does not equate marketing nicknames with the 2009 Block reorg unless a primary source says so."
* "Exact drop lists and modifier diffs need cited sources page-by-page (planned later)."
* AR 2.0: "(archived final PDF; wiki transcription labeled Legacy Virtual-era)".
* swccgpc.com capture: contact address tournaments@swccgpc.com; "This page does not invent a domain launch date beyond what that capture shows."
* 2009 domain move: the post noted expected hiccups and asked users to report issues on the forums (ref domain2009).
* "This wiki cross-links those resources but does not replace them."
* Sources list removed: every item is now a <ref>. logo.jpg (ref "pclogojpg"), VirtualCards1.pdf (ref "vc1pdf") and the star-wars.pl chronology (ref "swpl") were converted from the list or inline links.
